title: Enrichment Waterfall Benchmark
description: Open benchmark of B2B contact enrichment APIs: does a multi-provider waterfall find more verified work emails and working mobiles than a single-provider database? Clay's default waterfall, Clay limited to one provider, and two anonymized single-database providers enrich the same 500 contacts; every returned email and phone is checked by one independent verifier, and each endpoint is compared on verified emails, valid mobiles, company-data accuracy, cost per 1,000 verified emails and latency. This record holds the pre-registered method, the task, the scoring code, the Clay adapters and the aggregate results; the input contacts and raw vendor responses are not published.
